The learned Counsel further submits notwithstanding the binding nature of the said order, the investigating agency, in flagrant violation and utter disregard of the same, proceeded to transfer the investigation of the matter to Kandivali Police Station, Mumbai, purportedly on the ground of territorial jurisdiction.
2. Mr Siddharth Idhani, the learned Counsel, appears on behalf of the first informant and seeks time to file the intervention application.

The learned APP, however, seeks time to obtain necessary instructions from the Investigating Officer and makes a statement that the applicant will not be arrested in the present crime till the next date.
3. By consent, stand over to 6 August 2025.
